ledger: Woman | Leaning on car hood, intact anatomy | Torso intersecting car, deformed hands | Body clips through solid car parts, fingers merge unnaturally
Car | Vintage station wagon, defined features | Morphing features | Antenna disappears, hood ornament shifts shape

findings.description: The woman's torso visibly intersects and merges with the solid metal of the car's hood and fender, rather than resting on top of it, creating a physical impossibility.
The fingers on the woman's visible hand, resting on her arm, are deformed and merged together into an unnatural, blob-like shape.
The car's antenna vanishes, and the hood ornament morphs in shape and shifts position on the hood as the camera pans.
